title: Bound on iterated context length
statement: Let $f$ map finite bit strings to finite bit strings, and let $A$ be a natural number. Suppose that for every bit string $d$, the total first projection of $f(d)$ equals that of $d$, and $|f(d)|\le |d|+A\bigl(|\pi_1(d)|+1\bigr)$, where $\pi_1$ is the total first projection for the self-delimiting pair encoding. Then for all bit strings $c,d$ and all natural numbers $j\le |c|$, the $j$-fold iterate of $f$ at $d$ has length at most $(A+1)(|\langle c,d\rangle|+1)^2$, where $\langle c,d\rangle$ is the self-delimiting pair encoding.
